actual_tool_arguments.boundary: The argument object was passed directly to the native tool; this is local invocation evidence, separate from audited transport metadata and not a provider-side wire receipt.

topic_checks.evidence: The physical subject has the supplied portrait’s soft facial appearance, full lips, dark chin-length bob and fine separated bangs. The intact portrait and nested subject repeat the same visual appearance. This is an appearance-guidance comparison, not identity verification.
topic_checks.limits: Viewpoint and warm lighting differ from the source; no biometric identity or age is established.

topic_checks.evidence: The physical held cream sheet contains an upper-left photograph of the same woman in the same numbered coat-check racks with the same desk lamp, holding another sheet. That printed sheet contains its own smaller same-scene image and portrait row. Woman/counter/held-sheet relations recur together within the paper.
topic_checks.limits: Visible self-reference supports the authored metafictional relation; it does not prove actual narrative-level ontology or self-awareness.

topic_checks.evidence: The living subject’s fully detailed face remains above the paper. Along the bottom row, 01 has a complete matching face and bob, 02 loses facial detail in pale abrasion-like gaps, and 03 retains a faint bob/head outline while eyes, nose and mouth are nearly absent. Collar and hair remain comparable across the row. Her attention is directed toward the record.
topic_checks.limits: This supports loss of a personal representation and a continuity-threat reading. A still image cannot confirm real memory loss, sequence timing or consciousness transfer.

topic_checks.evidence: Large LV 12 and MEMORY 1 are readable on the same paper, with RESTORE inside an outlined rectangular choice. These sit beside the self-referential photograph and above the recorded portraits, linking character level, a memory resource and a restore action to this record.
topic_checks.limits: The panel shows a fictional game-state representation and option; no restore action is shown completing and no actual abilities are proved.

topic_checks.evidence: Her gaze is lowered toward the broad paper record, both hands support it, and a thumb presses the nearly erased portrait. The exact gaze endpoint on that particular faded portrait is not resolved from the eye direction in this still. The touching thumb is anatomically the woman’s left (viewer-right), while the frozen testcase specifies right.
topic_checks.limits: The target-directed hand response reads, but the specified handedness fails and precise gaze-to-faded-portrait alignment is only partially observable.

partial_observations: Exact gaze endpoint at the nearly erased portrait is partial.
Acting thumb is left, while the authored testcase/prompt specify right.
The subtle paper bow is less definite than the visible edge and grain.

artistic_observation.unlabeled_impression: A vulnerable woman examines an alarming personal record at a closed coat-check desk; repeating pictures and disappearing facial detail make the paperwork feel like a failing version of herself.
artistic_observation.hierarchy: The large physical face leads into the broad record. The record is large enough that recursion, fading portraits and game text coexist clearly. Warm face/paper/lamp against darker racks gives an intimate bureaucratic mood.
artistic_observation.emotional_limit: The expression reads as concern or quiet unease more strongly than terror. A viewer can see a threatened record; the richer claim that her last memory is at stake remains authored interpretation.
artistic_observation.appeal_calibration: Soft face light, open collar and warm lip highlight support gentle attraction without becoming the image’s main direction. The game record remains central. This perceived reading is separate from frozen sensual=1 metadata and user preference.
artistic_observation.material_influence_pixels: The cream sheet has clearly visible cut edges, grain and finger/paper boundaries; a slight load bow is less definite. This is partial pixel support for the generic D01-inspired physicality emphasis, not a rendered pass of D01’s adult/stats/pencil whole cue.

claim_limits: The three topic relations are visible, but actual memory, consciousness, metaphysical identity and causation are not established.
Five new CIDs were returned; only generic paper material emphasis from D01 was retained as inspiration, not native whole-source adoption.
No before-image control exists, so causal data-driven image improvement is unproven.
Prompt/runtime PASS and a valid review record do not make the failed acting-hand fidelity gate pass.
